verified_facts.text: Alila Ventana Big Sur is a resort on the California coast overlooking the Pacific Ocean and surrounded by redwood forest.
verified_facts.excerpt: Alila Ventana Big Sur is a luxury resort on the California coast, overlooking the Pacific Ocean, surrounded by redwood forest, and tailored to adults.

verified_facts.text: The resort is tailored to adults.
verified_facts.excerpt: Alila Ventana Big Sur is a luxury resort on the California coast, overlooking the Pacific Ocean, surrounded by redwood forest, and tailored to adults.

verified_facts.text: The resort is near Pfeiffer Beach, Bixby Bridge and Point Sur Lighthouse.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located near Pfeiffer Beach, Bixby Bridge and Point Sur Lighthouse, the resort provides access to iconic Big Sur attractions.

verified_facts.text: Breakfast, lunch and dinner are included throughout the stay, with dinner on the arrival day and breakfast on the departure day.
verified_facts.excerpt:
- Dinner on your arrival day
- Breakfast on your departure day
- Breakfast, lunch and dinner throughout your stay

verified_facts.text: Meadow Pool has views of the ocean and redwood forest, private cabanas and an infinity-edge hot tub.
verified_facts.excerpt: Meadow Pool delivers expansive views of the ocean and redwood forest, as well as private cabanas and an infinity-edge hot tub.

verified_facts.text: The secluded Mountain Pool sits high atop the resort among redwoods, next to Japanese hot baths for communal bathing.
verified_facts.excerpt: Meanwhile, our secluded Mountain Pool is perched high atop the resort, surrounded by towering redwoods, with adjacent Japanese hot baths offering a serene communal bath experience.

verified_facts.text: Most rooms and suites have wood-burning fireplaces, decks with ocean or forest views and private hot tubs.
verified_facts.excerpt: Most of our 54 rooms and suites feature wood-burning fireplaces, decks with ocean or forest views and private hot tubs.

verified_facts.text: Guests can stay in a standalone villa or in glamping sites.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy extra privacy in a standalone villa or relax in nature in one of our glamping sites.

verified_facts.text: The two-story Big Sur Villa has ocean and forest views, a private deck and a living area with a fireplace.
verified_facts.excerpt: Stay in our two-story, 1,000-square-foot Big Sur Villa, featuring ocean and forest views, a private deck and a living area with a fireplace.

verified_facts.text: The Cottage is a standalone villa with a private deck with a hammock, forest canyon views and an outdoor hot tub.
verified_facts.excerpt: choose this 725-square-foot standalone villa, featuring one king bed and a private deck with a hammock, forest canyon views and an outdoor hot tub.

verified_facts.text: Complimentary seasonal programming includes guided hikes, forest bathing, meditation, wellness classes and nature experiences.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy complimentary seasonal programming inspired by Big Sur, including guided hikes, forest bathing, meditation, wellness classes and nature experiences.

verified_facts.text: Spa Alila combines intuitive traditions from Indonesia with holistic techniques from Europe.
verified_facts.excerpt: Big Sur provides a setting for natural healing combined with intuitive traditions from Indonesia and holistic techniques from Europe.

verified_facts.text: Guests can join a master falconer for an introduction to hawks, falcons and owls.
verified_facts.excerpt: join a master falconer for an unforgettable introduction to hawks, falcons and owls

verified_facts.text: The Glass House offers private dining with ocean views and a prix fixe menu.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our exquisite Glass House and its breathtaking ocean views create a private dining experience like no other. Perched on the edge of the continent, your party will enjoy a prix fixe menu

verified_facts.text: The Sur House cuisine features fresh ingredients from the resort's organic garden, and its terrace has ocean views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Ocean views from the terrace area are as breathtaking as our Big Sur-inspired cuisine, which features fresh ingredients from our expansive organic garden.

verified_facts.text: Accommodations are limited to a maximum of two guests per room.
verified_facts.excerpt: our accommodations are limited to a maximum of two guests per room.

verified_facts.text: The resort does not offer amenities, programming or an environment typically suited to guests traveling with children.
verified_facts.excerpt: does not offer amenities, programming, or an environment typically suited to guests traveling with children.

verified_facts.text: Dogs can join guests for meals outside on The Sur House Terrace, weather permitting.
verified_facts.excerpt: dogs are invited to join you for breakfast, lunch, and dinner outside on The Sur House Terrace, weather permitting.

verified_facts.text: The resort is set 1,200 feet above the Pacific, surrounded by meadows and wooded hillsides.
verified_facts.excerpt: set on 243 acres of meadows and wooded hillsides 1,200 feet above the Pacific, surrounded on all sides by epic nature.

verified_facts.text: Cell reception at the resort is very limited.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Wi-Fi is free, but the cell reception is pretty much nonexistent.

verified_facts.text: The rooms combine mid-century and rustic-chic style with working fireplaces, stone and wood.
verified_facts.excerpt: the 59 mid-century-meets-rustic-chic rooms now feature working fireplaces, muted colors, lots of stone and wood

verified_facts.text: Guests can join a group class at the Ventana beehives.
